name: Tikka Masala Eggs with Spinach & Garlic Naan

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 4 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; peel and halve.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Seed and small dice bell peppers; transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic, then set aside ⅓ of the garlic for the naan. Peel and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add bell pepper, garlic, and onion. Season with spices and cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables have softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp cumin
1 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp coriander
¾ tsp chili powder

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato sauce to the skillet and bring to a simmer. Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful; simmer 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from heat.
Let the skillet sit for 5 minutes, then stir in yogurt.
Meanwhile, quarter and toast the naan. Drizzle with oil and spread with reserved garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 flatbreads or naan
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide masala, eggs, and naan between bowls. Enjoy!
